svg.title: Where NEO overtakes GPU-only
svg.text: Throughput of NEO with its CPU launch time measured on the machine, divided by the same engine run GPU-only at the same KV budget.
Mean of all rounds (3 rounds at the crossover cells, otherwise 2); above the line NEO is faster. Closed loop of N clients, 128 output tokens.
